NAME:
   rancher skill status - Report, for each harness, the installed skill version and whether its files are unchanged

USAGE:
   rancher skill status [flags]

FLAGS:
   --agent all          target harness (or all; default all)
   --help, -h           show help
   --require-installed  fail when a selected target is absent
   --scope scope        install location scope to check: user or project (default user)

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
